notes.BANN: The campus map's Bannan Center is OSM's two buildings at 817 11th Ave (Bannan Engineering and Bannan Science); the code goes on the larger, Bannan Engineering, so schedules saying BANN land there.
notes.FINR: The campus map's Fine Arts Building is Seattle U's at 1011 E Madison St (OSM way/117996761); the name match had picked Seattle Central's Fine Arts Building on E Pine St.
notes.SUPK: Seattle University Park is open space, not a class building; the word match had joined it to an unrelated 'Union Park' building west of campus.
notes.student-center: The Student Center holds Cherry Street Market, Seattle U's main dining hall (seattleu.edu dining); OSM names it only Student Center.
notes.chapel-of-saint-ignatius: Chapel (religious building). Not somewhere undergraduates have class.
notes.1313-east-columbia-building: Offices: Public Safety, Facilities Services, Human Resources, Budget and Procurement (seattleu.edu office directory). Not somewhere undergraduates have class.
